messages:
sasha: Heads-up: sketching a different approach for the next DP/beta run. thinking of a staggered cohort model (3 waves) + small incentives to reduce dropouts. want quick alignment on gating, incentives, and how we define a "successful exit" so PMs can prioritize roadmap items accordingly.

lina: sounds good. can you share the high-level goals? e.g., are we validating UX flows, infra controls, or pricing/ops impact?

sasha: primary goals: 1) validate private/dedicated onboarding friction and routing controls; 2) collect high-signal paired-eval prompts for key verticals; 3) measure incremental cost delta for caching/quantization knobs. secondary: surfacing console usability issues.

kevin: ops POV  make sure incentives don't inflate usage and skew cost metrics. suggest reward via gift card + product credit & require a minimum weekly activity threshold to qualify.

julia: agree. propose three waves of ~6 partners each: wave A = low-friction hosted (quick feedback), wave B = dedicated/private early adopters (longer onboarding), wave C = high-risk integrators (legal-heavy). each wave 4 weeks active + 1 week wrap.

michael: for scope negotiation with partners: we should commit to a limited set of toggles/features per wave (e.g., routing, kv-cache, rollback policy) and a fixed model-only list. that reduces support surface.

sasha: exactly. i'm drafting a gating rubric that decides who goes into which wave. rough idea below. open to edits.

```
STAGGERED COHORT GATING RUBRIC (draft)
- Wave A (hosted): must have production playground usage, <2 infra tickets in past month, agree to 20-min weekly check-ins.
- Wave B (dedicated/private): must have SSO, infra contact, and willingness to sign minimal data handling addendum.
- Wave C (legal/regulated): existing contract & legal team contact; expect 3-6 week legal cadence.
- Universal pass: provide 10 representative prompt pairs (happy + critical failure case) within 72h of selection.
- Dropout protection: partner must meet 2 of 3 engagement signals by week 2 (login, 1 inference/day, weekly survey).
```

lina: add a QA gate: require that each partner's first successful inference is validated by our test harness and paired eval baseline before we flip any config to dedicated.

kevin: incentive details suggestion: $150 gift card + $500 product credit for full completion, prorated for partial. credit applied to next quarter billing. require partner agreement to anonymized telemetry.

julia: could we instead offer incremental incentives per wave completion to keep them engaged across waves (e.g., micro-rewards after each wave)? that might reduce churn.

michael: on exit criteria: recommend we treat a partner as "successful exit" if 1) they complete all scheduled feedback sessions; 2) pass paired-eval regression threshold (no >10% regression on key prompts); 3) signed short reference blurb or completed NPS >= 7.

sasha: i like that. add product ask: for any partner that hits "successful exit", product gets 3 prioritized prompts for model tuning + 2 hours of on-site pairing (remote) for workflow mapping.

lina: regarding feedback loops: prefer structured capture: short micro-survey after each sync (5 questions), one paired-eval batch every 2 weeks, and a central issue tag "dp-beta-prio" in our bug tracker for anything blocking adoption.

kevin: ops blocker: cluster quota currently has 2 large jobs this timeframe. need to reserve a buffer pool and label it dp-beta-waveA/B/C to avoid preemption. i can file the quota request today.

julia: recruitment pipeline: target lists per wave. wave A candidates: PixelApps, HarborAI, UnitLabs, NeonDocs, QuickForms, EchoAI. wave B: DataForge, OrionOps, StreamEdge, AcmeHealth, DeltaFin, ClearBank (standby). wave C: MedSecure, ReguCorp (likely legal).

michael: legal note: we need a trimmed data handling addendum for Wave B to speed signoff. legal ETA usually 2-3 weeks; propose a templated addendum.

sasha: action items: kevin reserves capacity; michael drafts invite + addendum; lina builds intake form + paired-eval rubric; julia drafts incentive payout flow; i'll coordinate outreach and wave scheduling.

lina: small nit: define "paired-eval regression threshold" concretely. michael suggested 10% but we need to decide on metric (F1, BLEU, or human preference). propose human-paired preference where >90% prefer baseline or no significant downgrade.

michael: agree on human preference. we'll instrument a 50-sample paired test per partner per wave and compute win-rate. threshold: >=90% baseline win-rate or no >10pp drop vs baseline.

sasha: blockers?

kevin: blocker: GPU quota + ops rota.

julia: blocker: need marketing copy for invite (positioning as "early design partner" perks). can someone from comms help?

michael: i can draft basic copy; will ask comms for a landing page.

lina: blocker: need a tiny script to ingest partner prompt sets into the paired-eval harness (ETA: 3 days).

sasha: timeline proposal: outreach this week, wave A kickoff in 3 weeks, wave B kickoff 6 weeks, wave C by 10 weeks. feedback: shorter waves ok?

julia: 4 weeks per wave feels right to capture infra changes.

michael: final ask  can we lock owners in calendar for weekly syncs per wave? i'll create the calendar blocks and include partners.

(dp-bot): Ticket created: BETA-221 "staggered-dp-cohort-2025" (assignee: sasha).
